**User Story**
A user story of the feature request you want.

**Acceptance Criteria**
A list of criteria needed to be fulfilled for the feature to work as you intend.

**Definitions of Done:**
- [ ] All acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Code is reviewed and approved.
- [ ] Necessary tests are written and pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, if applicable.
